name: podcast-hero
title: Podcast hero
description: A podcast's opening: cover art, the latest episode with a Play button that hands off to your player, and where to listen as plain text links.
docs: Pass the show (title, hosts, description and an optional square cover with its alt text) and the latest episode: duration is in seconds and is written "48 min" and spoken "48 minutes", publishedAt is an ISO day, a timestamp or a Date. Leave the cover out and the hero sets one from the show name, black on white or the reverse. onPlay(episode) is where you tell your player what to play; the player itself lives elsewhere. Hand its state back with playing and the button says Pause and the card says Now playing; onPause is called then, or onPlay again if you leave it out, so one handler can toggle. listenLinks are services named in text, such as Apple Podcasts, Spotify and RSS, instead of logos, in a list named after the show so two shows on a page are told apart. Pass locale and timeZone for the dates and lengths, and labels to translate the fixed words. onPlay and onPause are functions, so use the hero inside a Client Component.
